-improved AI behavior
-fixed unfog bug on the level selection

notes.title: First patch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40617003/98ff10af4096f8c622fb801ed376c25e4ae23599.png[/img]

Patch nr 1.

- improved performance on Level Selection
- improved overall performance, especially on low-quality settings and during destroying objects
- fixed low audio volume after the kamikaze blast
- fixed missing veggies discovery animation after starting a new game
- fixed not disappearing interaction info after returning to the menu (or Level Selection)
- fixed strange camera rotation when zooming at certain islands (Level Selection)
- fixed aiming speed on the joystick (a little bit faster)
- fixed input on mission panels ( axes, mouse move, or ESC button are not taken into account)
- fixed dithering after the kamikaze blast
- fixed some translations bugs

notes.title: Q&A
notes.content:
[h2]Q&A[/h2]

1.[b]When is the game released?[/b]
Our game in the early access version will be released in January 2022.
2.[b]How much will the game cost?[/b] 
The early access version of the game will cost $6.99. The full version of the game will cost $9.99.
3.[b]How long is "Suicide Vegetables" gameplay?[/b]
The duration of the game in the early access version is about 3 hours. The full version takes about 5 hours.
4.[b]Will the game also be available on consoles? which ones?[/b]
Yes, our game will also be available on Nintendo Switch.
5.[b]What are your development plans after the game's release in early access?[/b]
We would like to invite players to work together to create the full version of the game. We would like to implement players' ideas into the game's plot and the process of creating new missions.
